note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground overlooking 1,320-acre Van Etten Lake near the former Wurtsmith Air Force Base, 4.5 mi NW of Oscoda via US-23 and F-41. A walking path lines the water's edge; boating access site on the south side of the campground (perch, walleye, pike, bass). The Iron Belle Trail is reached south of the campground via F-41 and River Road; ORVs and snowmobiles are prohibited in the campground (Old State House ORV trailhead 5.5 mi SW). Advisory: MDHHS fish-consumption guidelines (elevated PFOS) and advice to avoid swallowing foam on Van Etten Lake, as high levels of PFAS may be present. --Claude
